# AlgoPrimer
> Free, developer-native educational platform teaching programming, computer science fundamentals, and Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA) from first principles to technical interview readiness.

AlgoPrimer provides comprehensive curricula without paywalls or ad bloat:
- **Canonical 20-Topic DSA Roadmap**: Sequenced from time complexity analysis to dynamic programming and advanced patterns.
- **Curated Problem Bank (65 High-Frequency Problems)**: Full quad-lingual implementations in Java, C++, Python, and JavaScript across Brute Force, Better, and Optimal approaches with dry runs and complexity bounds.
- **Language Tracks (108 Lessons)**: Deep language mechanics, memory layouts, and standard collections for Java, C++, Python, and JavaScript.
- **Rapid Revision Cards**: High-yield 5-minute technical review cards with complexity tables and beginner pitfalls.

## Core Hubs & Roadmaps
- [DSA Roadmap](https://algoprimer.com/dsa): Sequenced 20-topic curriculum covering linear structures, trees, graphs, heaps, dynamic programming, and interview patterns.
- [Curated Interview Sheets](https://algoprimer.com/sheets): High-yield practice sheets including Blind 75 and Top 50 FAANG with 3-tier solutions.
- [Company Coding Sheets](https://algoprimer.com/companies): Verified hiring processes and interview problem sheets for Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta, Apple, Bloomberg, and Goldman Sachs.
- [Engineering Progression Roadmap](https://algoprimer.com/roadmap): 8-stage progression roadmap from zero coding fundamentals to senior technical interview readiness.
- [Curated Problem Bank](https://algoprimer.com/problems): 65 high-frequency placement problems with 3-tier solutions, complexity tables, and dry runs.
- [Programming Language Tracks](https://algoprimer.com/languages): First-principles language curricula for Java, C++, Python, and JavaScript.
- [Rapid Revision Cards](https://algoprimer.com/revision): High-yield revision cards covering Big-O boundaries, memory layouts, and core idioms.
- [Technical Interview Guide](https://algoprimer.com/interview): In-depth guide to Online Assessments (OA), Live Coding rubrics, and Core CS (OS, DBMS, CN).

## 20-Topic Canonical DSA Curriculum
- [Time & Space Complexity](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/complexity): Big-O notation, asymptotic analysis, worst vs average case, and the 10^8 operations rule.
- [Arrays & Dynamic Arrays](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/arrays): Contiguous memory layout, two pointers, prefix sums, sliding window, and Kadane's algorithm.
- [Strings & Pattern Matching](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/strings): String immutability, ASCII/Unicode representation, anagrams, palindrome patterns, and KMP basics.
- [Linear & Binary Search](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/searching): Search space reduction, monotonic functions, lower/upper bounds, and binary search on answer.
- [Sorting Fundamentals](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/sorting): Merge Sort, Quick Sort, stability, comparison vs non-comparison sorting.
- [Hashing & Hash Maps](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/hashing): Hash functions, collision resolution, load factors, and frequency counting.
- [Two Pointers Technique](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/two-pointers): Oppositely directed, same-direction (fast & slow), and cycle detection.
- [Sliding Window Pattern](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/sliding-window): Fixed-size windows, dynamically shrinking windows, and substring frequency tracking.
- [Linked Lists](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/linked-lists): Singly, doubly, dummy head nodes, pointer reversal, and cycle detection.
- [Recursion & Backtracking](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/recursion-backtracking): Call stack frames, base cases, choice-explore-unchoose recursion trees, and pruning.
- [Stacks & Monotonic Stack](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/stacks): LIFO discipline, parentheses balancing, evaluation, and next greater element patterns.
- [Queues, Deques & Monotonic Queue](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/queues): FIFO queues, circular buffers, double-ended queues, and sliding window maximum.
- [Trees & Binary Trees](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/trees): Hierarchical data structures, DFS (inorder, preorder, postorder), BFS level order, height, and diameter.
- [Binary Search Trees (BST)](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/binary-search-tree): BST invariant, search, insert, delete, and validation.
- [Heaps & Priority Queues](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/heaps): Min-heaps, max-heaps, complete binary trees in arrays, and top-K frequent elements.
- [Graphs](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/graphs): Adjacency matrix vs list, BFS, DFS, cycle detection, topological sort (Kahn's), and Dijkstra.
- [Dynamic Programming](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/dynamic-programming): Overlapping subproblems, optimal substructure, memoization vs tabulation, and knapsack variants.
- [Greedy Algorithms](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/greedy): Locally optimal choices, interval scheduling, and fractional knapsack.
- [Bit Manipulation](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/bit-manipulation): Bitwise operations, two's complement, power of two checks, and XOR cancellation.
- [Trie (Prefix Tree)](https://algoprimer.com/dsa/trie): Prefix trees, word dictionary search, and autocomplete patterns.

## Programming Language Tracks
- [Java Curriculum](https://algoprimer.com/languages/java): JVM architecture, primitive types vs wrapper classes, Collections Framework, garbage collection.
- [C++ Curriculum](https://algoprimer.com/languages/cpp): Direct memory pointers, references, RAII, Standard Template Library (STL), and iterators.
- [Python Curriculum](https://algoprimer.com/languages/python): Object references, dynamic typing, list comprehensions, heapq, bisect, and Big-O overheads.
- [JavaScript Curriculum](https://algoprimer.com/languages/javascript): V8 execution context, closures, event loop, Promises, async/await, and prototypal inheritance.

## Representative Problems & Patterns
- [Two Sum](https://algoprimer.com/problems/two-sum): Hash Map complement lookup ($O(N)$ time, $O(N)$ space).
- [Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock](https://algoprimer.com/problems/best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock): Single-pass minimum tracking ($O(N)$ time, $O(1)$ space).
- [Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters](https://algoprimer.com/problems/longest-substring-without-repeating-characters): Dynamic sliding window with hash set/map ($O(N)$ time, $O(\min(N, M))$ space).
- [Trapping Rain Water](https://algoprimer.com/problems/trapping-rain-water): Two pointers converging elevation tracking ($O(N)$ time, $O(1)$ space).
- [Reverse Linked List](https://algoprimer.com/problems/reverse-linked-list): Iterative 3-pointer pointer manipulation and recursive reversal ($O(N)$ time, $O(1)$ space).
- [Course Schedule](https://algoprimer.com/problems/course-schedule): Directed graph cycle detection via Kahn's algorithm (BFS) and DFS ($O(V + E)$ time).
